test_asyncio_run_wrapper: test the iterating asyncio_run_wrapper function to run coroutines safely inside or outside an existing event loop
test_async_iterator_to_sync: test the iterating async_iterator_to_sync context manager to convert an async iterator into a synchronous iterator
test_sync_iterator_to_async: test the iterating sync_iterator_to_async context manager to convert a synchronous iterator into an async iterator
test_merge: test the iterating merge function to combine multiple async iterators into a single parallel async iterator
test_to_thread: test the iterating to_thread decorator to run blocking functions as awaitable coroutines with optional timeout
